dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Low-contrast, thin pale grayish fringes are visible on the secondary coverts, but do not form thick or distinct horizontal bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Moderate visibility; thin pale linear boundaries are discernible along the edges of the folded flight feathers against darker feather bodies.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized orange-rufous patch is visible near the upper wing/scapular junction; a distinct white spot is present on the distal tip of the visible tail feather.
